disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and does not substitute professional medical advice. Herb-drug interactions can be unpredictable and vary based on individual metabolism, dosage, and specific drug formulations. Always consult a healthcare provider or qualified clinical herbalist before combining herbs with pharmaceutical medications.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Ashwagandha has sedative properties that may have additive effects when combined with CNS depressants, leading to excessive drowsiness.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Use with caution; monitor for excessive sedation.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: May increase thyroid hormone synthesis and secretion, potentially leading to hyperthyroid symptoms if taking thyroid replacement.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Monitor thyroid function tests closely; dosage adjustment of the medication may be needed.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Ashwagandha is an immunostimulant and may counteract the effects of medications intended to suppress the immune system.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Avoid use in patients on immunosuppressive therapy.

interactions.general_cautions: Avoid during pregnancy. Use cautiously in hyperthyroidism.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Curcumin inhibits platelet aggregation, increasing the risk of bleeding when combined with blood thinners.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Avoid therapeutic doses of curcumin. Dietary culinary amounts are generally safe. Stop use 2 weeks prior to surgery.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Turmeric may lower blood sugar levels, increasing the risk of hypoglycemia when combined with diabetes drugs.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Monitor blood glucose levels; medication adjustments may be required.

interactions.general_cautions: Caution in patients with gallstones or bile duct obstruction.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Inhibits platelet aggregation. High doses (>4g/day) may increase bleeding risk.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Monitor INR if taking Warfarin. Keep doses moderate (<2g/day).

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: May enhance insulin release and lower blood glucose.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Monitor blood sugar levels.

interactions.general_cautions: May exacerbate heartburn in sensitive individuals at high doses.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Decreases platelet aggregation and may have fibrinolytic activity.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements if on blood thinners. Stop 10 days before surgery.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Garlic induces CYP450 3A4, reducing the blood levels and efficacy of some protease inhibitors.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Strictly avoid garlic supplements.

safe_with: Culinary use is generally safe with most drugs except severe bleeding risks.
interactions.general_cautions: Can cause GI upset.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Neem has potent hypoglycemic effects.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Monitor blood glucose closely; high risk of hypoglycemia.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Neem stimulates the immune system.
drugs_that_interact.recommendation: Avoid combination.

interactions.general_cautions: Strictly avoid in pregnancy and those trying to conceive (has contraceptive properties). Avoid in children (risk of Reye's-like syndrome).

interactions.general_cautions: Use caution in pregnancy due to mild downward-moving (apana) effect.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: May lower blood glucose.

interactions.general_cautions: Avoid consuming Moringa root or its extracts during pregnancy (may cause uterine contractions).

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Brahmi increases acetylcholine levels; additive effect with Alzheimer's drugs.

drugs_that_interact.mechanism: Brahmi may stimulate thyroid hormone production.
